commands.review_summary:
The PR adds an Alibaba Token Plan API region enum, settings picker, regional URL/request/cookie handling, settings snapshot storage, and focused tests for International and China-mainland endpoints.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main hardcodes Bailian/cn-beijing and scopes imported cookies to those URLs, so Model Studio-scoped cookies will not match the Token Plan cookie import path. I did not run live Alibaba probes because they can require real account cookies or Keychain access.
